scope: Real Ultralytics YOLO26n detect + YOLO26n-pose through vision/yolo_source.py on still images, on FADI's Mac mini (Apple M4) CPU and MPS. Not the Orin Nano, not TensorRT, no camera, no arm.

environment.isolated: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with ultralytics --with opencv-python-headless (cache in vision/local/uv-cache, git-ignored)

method: imgsz 640, conf 0.25. adapter_ms is one UltralyticsDetector call (detect, then pose, then conversion to FrameDetections), median of 10 after one untimed warm-up. inference_ms is Ultralytics' own per-model inference time from a separate call. Excludes camera capture and decode.

results.what: Left half of docs/images/maker-arm-right-cylinder-lift.jpg (real station photo, side view, yellow foam cylinder in the right gripper, people in the background)
Right half of the same photo (real wrist-camera view, cylinder between the open jaws)
turn_gate/local/woman_hands.jpg (real photo, two raised hands, no can)
ultralytics/assets/bus.jpg shipped with the package (real photo, several people)
SYNTHETIC: a red can drawn with OpenCV on a flat background, not a photo

checked: Every call returned FrameDetections(valid=True, source='ultralytics'); all boxes passed Detection validation (normalized [0,1], ordered corners).
Labels out: person, bottle, cup from the detect model; person plus hand (built from pose wrists) from the pose model. MomentTracker uses hand, bottle, cup; person is ignored.
The tracker reached sensible states: two hands -> HAND multiple_hands; a lone cup -> EMPTY (motion allowed, nothing requests a turn); a background person's hands -> HAND empty_hand.
issues: Pose-derived hand boxes sit on the wrist, not over the palm and fingers: on woman_hands.jpg both 0.1-frame boxes cover the wrist while the fingers extend well past them. A can held in the fingers may not overlap the hand box. Tune hands_from_pose reach (0.35) and hand_box_size (0.1) on the real camera before trusting offer_started.
Person boxes come from both models (duplicates); harmless because the tracker ignores person.

The real yellow cylinder came back as 'bottle' 0.329 in the side view, under MomentConfig.min_confidence 0.35, so the tracker ignores it there; the wrist view saw it as 'cup' 0.517. Our demo can still needs a check on the real camera.

verdict: YOLO26n and YOLO26n-pose resolve by name in Ultralytics 8.4.207 and run through the existing adapter unchanged. On this Mac: about 48-53 ms per frame for both models on CPU, about 22-26 ms on MPS (Ultralytics inference about 21-27 ms per model on CPU, 3-4 ms on MPS).
not_established: Orin Nano latency, TensorRT export or JetPack 7.2.1 install (pending the Jetson test).
Live camera loop latency, including capture.
Detection of the actual demo can, and of a can held in a hand (no such photo was available on this Mac).
local_artifacts: vision/local/ultralytics/still_check.json (full report with boxes), vision/local/ultralytics/annotated/*.jpg (boxes drawn), both git-ignored

live_loop_on_a_clip_of_stills.what: vision.run --video on a 3 s, 30 fps MP4 made from three of the stills (30 identical frames each: wrist cylinder, woman_hands, side cylinder), real models on MPS, --target real, --record and --telemetry. Exercises the live loop's file path with real Ultralytics; it is not a camera and the frames do not move.
live_loop_on_a_clip_of_stills.command: python -m vision.run --video vision/local/ultralytics/stills-clip.mp4 --detect vision/local/ultralytics/weights/yolo26n.pt --pose vision/local/ultralytics/weights/yolo26n-pose.pt --device mps --target real --record vision/local/ultralytics/stills-clip-trace.jsonl --telemetry vision/local/sessions
live_loop_on_a_clip_of_stills.invalid_reason: the read after the last frame (end of file) is reported as read_failed, as designed
live_loop_on_a_clip_of_stills.max_note: the first frame includes MPS warm-up; warm it up before trusting the first second of a live run
live_loop_on_a_clip_of_stills.telemetry: session vision-video-20261108-stills-clip-mps: 9 events, 0 invalid (python3 -m control_center validate)

verifier_rerun.what: Independent verifier rerun of one still check from the cached env, offline (YOLO_OFFLINE=1, Ultralytics settings sync=false), while other agents were loading the Mac.
verifier_rerun.command: YOLO_OFFLINE=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=vision/local/uv-cache uv run --offline --no-project --python 3.12 --with ultralytics --with opencv-python-headless python -m vision.still_check --detect vision/local/ultralytics/weights/yolo26n.pt --pose vision/local/ultralytics/weights/yolo26n-pose.pt --device cpu --device mps --repeat 5 woman_hands.jpg station-side-cylinder.jpg
verifier_rerun.matches_original: Labels, counts, confidences and tracker states identical (woman_hands: 2 person, 2 hand, HAND multiple_hands; side cylinder: bottle 0.329, hand 0.856, HAND empty_hand). Latency a few ms slower than the original run under load (n=5), same order.

analytics_note: The original runs used Ultralytics' default settings (sync=true) while online, so Ultralytics most likely sent its anonymous usage analytics events for predict mode. The git-ignored config under vision/local/ultralytics/config now has sync=false, and the documented Mac command sets YOLO_OFFLINE=1.
